svg.text: ENTERPRISE AI MODEL STORAGE, P2P DISTRIBUTION & 32-NODE GPU COLD-START ARCHITECTURE
Cut 32-Node 140GB vLLM Cold Start from 18.5 Min to 13.5 Sec (82x Faster, -86.2% TCO)
32 GPU Nodes Scaling 140GB Weights: Tier 1 Direct S3 Pull (1,110s, $98K/mo) vs. Tier 3 Dedicated Lustre ($64K/mo) vs. Tier 4 P2P + Local NVMe (13.5s, $13.5K/mo)
⛔ Tier 1 & 2 Traps: S3 Stampedes & Idle GPU Tax
1. Direct S3/Blob Pull per Pod on Scale-Out (1,110s = 18.5 Min):
• 32 pods simultaneously pull 140GB = 4.48 TB stampede across NAT/
S3 endpoints; forces 16 extra H100 GPUs kept idle 24/7 ($98K/mo)!
2. Shared Standard Cloud NAS (`EFS / Azure Files Standard`):
• 12 GB/s aggregate throughput divided across 32 concurrent pods
throttles each node to 370 MB/s -> 380s (6.3 min) cold start!
3. Always-On 100TB Managed Lustre (`FSx / ANF Ultra`) for Inference:
• Paying $64,000/mo 24/7 just to read static immutable weight files
Production Failure Impact (32 Nodes x 140GB Model Scale-Out):
• 32-Node Cold Start: 1,110s (Tier 1) | 380s (Tier 2)
• Object Store Stampede: 4.48 TB per scaling wave
• Monthly Idle GPU Buffer + Storage TCO: $98,000 / month
🏆 Tier 4: S3 + Dragonfly P2P + Local NVMe + Streamer
1. Dragonfly P2P 64MB Chunk Ring + Spegel Container P2P:
• Pulls only 140GB once from S3/Blob (not 4.48 TB!); 32 GPU nodes
exchange weight chunks over free 100Gbps intra-VPC network
2. Free Ephemeral Node-Local NVMe RAID0 Cache (`30TB/node`):
• Uses bundled local NVMe SSDs on H100/L40S VMs (`$0` extra cost)
to serve warm pod restarts at 25+ GB/s local throughput!
3. Run:ai Model Streamer / fastsafetensors (`O_DIRECT -> DMA`):
• Streams tensor shards in parallel directly into GPU VRAM in 13.5s
Tier 4 Verified Production Benchmarks:
• 32-Node Concurrent Cold Start: 13.5 sec (82.2x faster than Tier 1)
• S3 Egress Stampede Reduction: -96.9% (4.48 TB -> 0.14 TB)
• Monthly Total TCO: $13,500 / mo (-86.2% vs Tier 1, -78.9% vs Lustre)
